spaces.name: Welcome
spaces.headline: Welcome to Awelen Entrepreneurs
spaces.desc:
I'm glad you're here. Awelen Entrepreneurs is a community for people who want to find, start and grow a business of their own, whether you're looking for your first idea or already leading a team.

You'll learn through short video courses, ask questions, book private coaching and meet other founders at live events. Please take two minutes to read how things work and the guidelines below. They keep this a safe and useful place for everyone.

rules.title: Be kind and respectful
rules.text: Treat every member the way you want to be treated. Disagree with ideas if you must, but never attack the person.

rules.title: No bullying or harassment
rules.text: Insults, mocking, threats, tribal, religious or gender slurs and unwanted private messages are not allowed. Such posts are removed, and anyone who repeats them is removed from the community.

rules.title: Ask questions freely
rules.text: No question is too small. Everyone here started somewhere, and your question often helps someone who was too shy to ask.

rules.title: Seek help early
rules.text: Stuck on a lesson, an idea or a payment? Post in Community, send Awele a message or book a coaching session. Don't struggle alone.

rules.title: Network to get more from your course
rules.text: Introduce yourself, comment on other people's posts and join a hangout. Founders who learn alongside others finish more courses and build stronger businesses.

rules.title: Share and celebrate
rules.text: Post your progress, what you learned and your wins, and cheer others on when they share theirs.

rules.title: No spam or hard selling
rules.text: No unrelated adverts, chain messages or get-rich-quick schemes. If you offer a service, apply to be listed as an affiliate expert instead.

rules.title: Respect privacy
rules.text: Don't share other members' phone numbers, messages or business details outside the community without their permission.

rules.title: Report concerns
rules.text: If something feels wrong, tell Awele through Contact. Reports are handled quietly and fairly.

spaces.name: Announcements
spaces.headline: News and updates from Awelen
spaces.desc: Official updates from Awele: new courses and lessons, events, programme news and important changes. Only the creator posts here, so nothing important gets lost in the conversation.

spaces.name: Introduce yourself
spaces.headline: Say hello to the community
spaces.desc: New here? Tell us who you are and what you are building. A short introduction helps members welcome you and find people to learn with.

spaces.name: Courses
spaces.headline: Learn in tracks, at your own pace
spaces.desc: Courses are grouped into tracks. Choose the track that matches where you are, unlock a course, then work through its modules and lessons: short videos, handouts and quizzes.

spaces.name: Community
spaces.headline: Ask, share and learn together
spaces.desc: Post questions, share wins and get practical answers from Awele and other founders. No question is too small.

spaces.name: Private coaching & mentoring
spaces.headline: Private coaching & mentoring with Awele
spaces.desc: One-to-one coaching and mentoring for your money and your leadership. Start with a free 30-minute discovery call, choose the area that matters most to you right now, and work through it with Awele at your own pace, in complete confidence.

spaces.name: Hangout
spaces.headline: Meet other founders, informally
spaces.desc: Relaxed calls to meet members, swap stories and keep each other accountable. Free to join; just RSVP.

spaces.name: Live events
spaces.headline: Webinars and live teaching
spaces.desc: Register for upcoming webinars and live Q&A sessions. Your joining link is emailed before the event.

spaces.name: Member database
spaces.headline: Meet the people in this community
spaces.desc: Every member has a profile here. Search by name, city, business or skill to find people to learn from, partner with or buy from.

spaces.name: Affiliate members
spaces.headline: Find unique expertise, or earn as an affiliate
spaces.desc: Affiliate members are vetted experts you can hire for the skills a new business needs. They also earn a commission when someone joins a course through their personal link.

spaces.name: Contact the creator
spaces.headline: Get in touch
spaces.desc: Questions about a course, coaching or working together? Reach Awele directly or send a message below.

spaces.name: Links
spaces.headline: More from Awelen
spaces.desc: Websites and channels where you can find more of Awele's work.

spaces.name: eBook Collection
spaces.headline: Read further, at your own pace
spaces.desc: Short, practical eBooks that go deeper into the ideas in our courses. Some are free. The rest you buy once and keep reading for as long as you are a member.

spaces.name: The Crucible Circle
spaces.headline: Bring your toughest challenge to the Ideation Room
spaces.desc: Organisations submit complex strategic challenges. Carefully selected Expert Practitioners, guided by a Master Moderator, work through them in live sessions and return grounded, practical recommendations.

spaces.name: Business Solutions
spaces.headline: Hands-on help for real businesses
spaces.desc: Sometimes you don't need another course. You need a partner. Book a consultation for business setup, turnaround, investors, talent, incubation or private coaching.

spaces.name: AMLD Programme
spaces.headline: Advanced Management & Leadership Development
spaces.desc: Taught by people who have done it. Finished with the presence to lead at the top. This is the home of the AMLD programme: how it works, the six Studio Sprints, the faculty and options for organisations.

spaces.name: Executive Presence
spaces.headline: Be seen, heard and trusted in the rooms that matter
spaces.desc: AMLD’s capstone and a modern finishing school for leaders: executive communication, boardroom readiness, global protocol, personal brand and media readiness. Self-paced or as a live cohort.

spaces.name: Executive Peer-Circle
spaces.navSub: Top leaders share ideas on complex issues
spaces.headline: Where top leaders think through complex issues together
spaces.desc: A room for senior leaders, founders and AMLD learners. Bring a complex issue you’re facing, hear how peers at your level would approach it, and lend your experience to theirs. What is shared here stays here.

spaces.name: Portfolio Showcase
spaces.headline: Finished work from AMLD Studio Sprints
spaces.desc: When your studio team completes a sprint, share a short summary of the brief, your recommendation and what the client said. Keep client details confidential.

spaces.name: Faculty Lounge
spaces.headline: Private space for faculty
spaces.desc: For Professors of Practice, Academic Facilitators, Guild Mentors and the Programme Director: sprint planning, marking moderation and arranging cover. Hidden from members.

tracks.title: Idea Discovery & Starters
tracks.desc: For people at the very start: find an idea that fits you, understand the economy around it and turn it into a business that pays its way.

tracks.title: Management Foundation
tracks.desc: Build the core skills of running a business: spotting the right opportunities, reading the numbers and setting a clear direction.

tracks.title: Executive Leadership
tracks.desc: For leaders growing a business beyond themselves: scale with impact, think visually, lead change and build wealth that lasts.

tracks.title: Advanced Management & Leadership Development (AMLD)
tracks.desc: For founders and senior managers ready to run the business and lead leaders. Six-week Studio Sprints taught by Professors of Practice, finished with the Executive Presence capstone.

tracks.title: Solve
tracks.desc: Bring a real challenge. Put it before a room of expert practitioners, or get hands-on help for your business.

announcements.title: New: AMLD Studio Sprints and the Executive Presence Programme
announcements.body:
Advanced Management & Leadership Development is now taught in six-week Studio Sprints, led by Professors of Practice who have run businesses themselves. You work on a live brief from a real business and finish with a portfolio, not just a certificate.

The Executive Presence Programme is AMLD’s capstone. Take it self-paced, or apply for the live Cohort with personal critiques and the Presence Dinner.

Everything about both programmes now lives under Track 4 in the sidebar: the AMLD programme, Executive Presence and the Executive Peer-Circle.

announcements.title: Idea Discovery now has 5 modules and 32 lessons
announcements.body:
Idea Discovery has grown. It now runs from Finding Meaning in Life all the way to Exploring Your Idea Space, with 32 lessons in five modules.

If you have already unlocked the course, the new lessons are open to you now at no extra cost. Pick up where you left off.

announcements.title: The Crucible Circle is open for challenges
announcements.body: Organisations can now submit complex strategic challenges to the Ideation Room, and experienced practitioners can send an expression of interest to join as Expert Practitioners or Master Moderators.

announcements.title: Webinar: Pricing for profit in 2027
announcements.body: Join Awele for a live session on setting prices that keep you in business, with time for your questions. Register in Live events; your joining link is emailed before the session.
